name: Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort
insider_take: This 40-acre oceanfront paradise sits on legendary Wailea Beach, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once gathered, featuring the world's most elaborate hotel water complex with nine pools connected by rapids, slides, and waterfalls.
whats_special: The resort boasts the famous Hibiscus Pool with its 129-foot water slide, a swim-up bar, and the adult-only Serenity Pool perched cliffside. The property houses over $30 million in original artwork, including pieces by Botero and Léger, plus the exclusive Spa Grande—Hawaii's largest spa at 50,000 square feet with 40 treatment rooms.
pro_tip: Book the Canyon Activity Pool early in the day—the rope swing and water elevator are most enjoyable before afternoon crowds arrive, and don't miss the complimentary sunrise yoga on Wailea Beach.
dont_miss: The nightly Botero Lounge entertainment featuring local Hawaiian musicians, snorkeling at the adjacent Wailea Beach's turtle cleaning station, and exploring the resort's unique water features including the world's only water elevator in a hotel setting.
pros: Spectacular oceanfront location on Wailea Beach with pristine white sand
World-class spa featuring traditional Hawaiian healing treatments
Extensive water features including pools, waterslides, and grottos
Multiple award-winning restaurants with diverse culinary offerings
Luxurious accommodations with ocean views and Waldorf Astoria service standards
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting Waldorf Astoria positioning
Large resort property requiring walking distances between facilities
